name: Vellichor Institute
full_legal_name: Vellichor Institute for Applied Memory Sciences, Corponation
sovereign_territory: A sprawling lakeside research enclave on the northern Chicago shoreline called the Reading Room — low-rise brutalist buildings connected by enclosed skywalks, surrounded by manicured grounds that are aggressively off-limits to non-credentialed personnel
founding_story: Vellichor was chartered in 2133 as a nonprofit research foundation by a consortium of neuroscientists fleeing the collapse of three major university systems. It converted to full corponation status in 2139 when its memory-encoding patents became commercially viable and the founding board realized the humanitarian mission was incompatible with the revenue potential. The transition was bitter — four of the original twelve founders publicly resigned. The remaining eight became billionaires within 18 months.
security_force: The Archivist Corps — 2,100 personnel, unusually small for a corponation of Vellichor's size, but supplemented by extensive automated perimeter systems and a classified psychological screening program for all visitors. The Archivist Corps is notable for employing former Threadbare operatives from Silkworm Data, suggesting a deep institutional relationship between the two corponations.
key_detail: Vellichor's flagship commercial product, the Palimpsest Suite, allows selective encoding, suppression, and in some configurations outright replacement of episodic memory in consenting clients. The waiting list for full Palimpsest treatment currently stands at 14 years. Their black-market forgery problem — unauthorized Palimpsest procedures performed with stolen equipment — is considered one of the GLMZ corridor's most serious underground criminal enterprises.
relationship_to_big_20: Affiliated with Lacuna Genomics through a joint research treaty called the Continuity Accord, which pools genomic and neurological data in ways that civil liberties organizations have described as the most comprehensive surveillance architecture in human history. Vellichor's memory suppression services are rumored to be used by at least nine Big 20 corponations for executive liability management.
full_text: Vellichor Institute for Applied Memory Sciences, Corponation — stock designation VLCH, known as Vellichor, The Institute, or Memory House — operates from the Reading Room, a low-rise brutalist enclave on the northern Chicago shoreline where enclosed skywalks connect climate-controlled research wings and the grounds are kept immaculate and permanently restricted. Vellichor began in 2133 as a nonprofit research foundation, a refuge for neuroscientists displaced by the collapse of three major university systems, and spent six years publishing foundational work on episodic memory encoding before its patent portfolio became commercially explosive. The 2139 conversion to corponation status fractured the founding board: four resigned in public protest, eight became billionaires. That rupture is still felt in Vellichor's institutional culture, which maintains a studied academic aesthetic over what is functionally one of the most profitable neurotechnology operations in the corridor. The Palimpsest Suite — Vellichor's flagship product, capable of selective encoding, suppression, and replacement of episodic memory — carries a 14-year commercial waiting list. The black-market forgery industry that has grown up around stolen Palimpsest equipment is classified by GLMZ corridor authorities as a Tier One criminal enterprise. Security is handled by the 2,100-person Archivist Corps, notably lean for a Φ1.4 trillion entity, but supported by automated perimeter systems and a visitor psychological screening protocol whose specifics are classified. The Corps' heavy recruitment from Silkworm Data's Threadbare unit points toward an institutional relationship between the two corponations that neither confirms. Vellichor's Continuity Accord with Lacuna Genomics — pooling neurological and genomic data in a shared architecture — has drawn sustained condemnation from civil liberties organizations. Nine Big 20 corponations are rumored clients of Vellichor's executive liability memory services. None have confirmed it.

glmzTerritory.description: The Vellichor Campus — sprawling lakeside research enclave on the northern Chicago shoreline in Evanston, Zone 3. Occupies the former Northwestern University site. One of three functioning university-sovereigns in the Corridor. Admission by examination; residency by affiliation; Tier classification formally irrelevant within campus boundaries.
glmzTerritory.grayZoneRelationship: Admits Gray Zone applicants at the same examination standard as all others. The Tier 1 acceptance rate is documented at 0.003%. The Institute considers this proof of meritocracy.
